name: Whispers of Compulsion
description: The creature chooses up to three creatures it can see within 60 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw, or it takes 12 (2d8 + 3) psychic damage and must use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against one creature of the creature’s choice that the creature can see. Constructs and Undead are immune to this effect.
